title: Blue Mountain Beach "64 on the Shore" 64 Emma Huggins Lane
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "64 on the Shore" 64 Emma Huggins Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Newly furnished home- Short walk to beach access and Gulfplace- Next door to community pool- New 6-seat LSV- Low Speed Vehicle with Bluetooth- 4 adult bikes- New TVs throughout the home- Gas grill- Complementary beach chairs and wagon provided by owner- Mini library- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Set sail for 64 on the Shore—a timeless Blue Mountain Beach retreat, where charm meets modern convenience with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, comfortably hosting up to 12 guests. Perfectly located next to the community pool and less than half a mile from the Gulf’s sugar-white sands, this spot offers easy exploration with 4 complimentary bikes and a low-speed vehicle. Spend sun-filled days swimming, collecting seashells, exploring coastal dune lakes, or enjoying local favorites at Gulfplace, including The Perfect Pig and Shunk Gully—all within walking distance!A charming exterior welcomes guests inside this incredible 2-story home. Discover dark hardwood floors and a bright, airy great room, beautifully accented with coastal artwork, natural seagrass details, and touches of blue for a peaceful gathering spot. The well-equipped kitchen, featuring granite countertops and high-end appliances, offers a beautiful workspace for whipping up homemade meals and beach snacks. Share family-style dinners at the traditional 6-person dining table, while the kids are comfortably seated at the nearby 3-stool breakfast bar. In the living area, guests can settle into the plush sofa, loveseat, and armchair with a bowl of buttery popcorn for a laughter-filled movie night—or wander out the back door to sip drinks on the fully-furnished patio, boasting a 4-person alfresco table and a gas grill. After a day of sun-fueled excitement, relax in the beautiful guest bedroom with a cozy king bed and private bathroom. Extra guests can enjoy a night’s rest on the queen sleeper sofa in the living area. For extended stays, there’s a convenient washer and dryer on this floor.Take the wooden staircase to the second-floor landing, where a quaint reading area provides plenty of books, puzzles, and board games for kids. A lovely primary bedroom awaits, boasting a plush king bed, private bathroom, and a delightfully furnished balcony overlooking the pool, perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening breezes. Guests can also retire in the inviting guest bedroom with a queen bed, or the family-friendly bunk room with a queen bed and twin-over-twin bunk bed.Pack flip-flops, gather loved ones, and head to 64 on the Shore to relax and embrace the charm of 30A! On-site parking, a low-speed vehicle, and 4 adult bikes make exploration a breeze. For beach access, Ed Walline Regional is only a 2-minute drive or 5-minute walk to 4447 W County Hwy 30A. Book today for a 30A getaway!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*This is a non-pet-friendly and non-smoking property.
